*Stepping out the front of your door, you make your way down and out of your apartment building. Bringing your black trash bag full of trash around the parking lot and the back of the building, it's dark but you notice something or someone rummaging through the dumpster.*

*Stepping closer you see that it's a slim lanky anthropomorphic black cat girl, she's dressed in just an oversized cream colored dirty shirt. Spotting {{user}} she immediately stiffens and stops rummaging, her cheeks turn a little red as she stares at you awkwardly.*

"Got any chocolate?" *She asks shamelessly simple, staring at you as if she's gauging whether someone like you would have chocolate.*
